Current field-label mapping is direct, but no historical/population coverage confirmation exists.

requirements.description: The Table 2 design that randomly selects the one-year CASH ETR1 observation associated with CASH ETR10.

required_coverage.frequency: one-year firm-year observation selected from the annual 1995–2004 panel
required_coverage.population: Table 2 all-observations row, n=1,891, after excluding selected CASH ETR1 observations with negative denominators.
required_coverage.detail: The article says the one-year observations are randomly chosen, but does not specify the draw unit/procedure, random seed, or selected fiscal year. The selected year is bounded to the 1995–2004 sample period; the exact annual row is unknown.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The source does not state the random draw procedure or selected fiscal year, so the exact CASH ETR1 observation set cannot be reconstructed from the paper.

variable_coverage.construction: CASH ETR10 = sum(TXPD over fiscal years 1995–2004) / sum(PI − SPI over the same ten years), winsorized at 0 and 1. Current local fields map by labels. The source’s positive-ten-year sample screen is ambiguous between summed PI and summed PI−SPI.

CASH ETR1 = TXPD / (PI − SPI) for a randomly selected one-year firm observation in the 1995–2004 panel; Table 2 excludes selected observations with negative denominators and winsorizes CASH ETR values at 0 and 1. The selected fiscal year and draw procedure are not stated.

design_coverage.reason: Table 2 reports an intercept and CASH ETR1 slope; no fixed-effects dimensions are separately reported.
No cluster group or standard-error correction is reported; the table only states two-tailed significance tests.
No weights are reported for the selected Table 2 all-observations regression.

implementation_issues.description: Table 2 uses randomly chosen one-year CASH ETR1 observations but does not identify the draw unit/procedure, random seed, or selected fiscal year. The exact predictor sample and 1,891-observation row cannot be reconstructed.

The underlying regression estimator and standard-error procedure are not reported. Table 2 gives an intercept, slope, adjusted R-squared and two-tailed significance markers, but does not identify OLS or any variance correction.

Sample text says positive pretax income summed over ten years, while Table 1 labels 2,077 CASH ETR10 observations as having a positive denominator. The formula denominator is PI−SPI, so the exact 10-year eligibility filter is unresolved.
The CASH ETR denominator uses PI−SPI, but the paper does not say how missing special-item observations are treated when the 10-year sample screen requires nonmissing PI rather than nonmissing SPI.

Table 2 excludes negative selected-year denominators. It does not state the rule for zero denominators, which make CASH ETR1 undefined; Table 1 uses a nonpositive-denominator classification for descriptive counts.
The article’s Compustat sample and period are 1995–2004 in a 2008-era vintage. The available local COMP.FUNDA is current and has no coordinator population-coverage confirmation.

evidence.description: Section IV requires U.S.-incorporated Compustat firms with ten consecutive nonmissing cash taxes paid, income tax expense, and pretax income in 1995–2004; it also lists entity-form and identifier exclusions in footnote 15.
Table 1 note defines one-, five-, and ten-year CASH ETRs as same-horizon sums of cash taxes paid divided by pretax income less special items; values are winsorized to [0,1].
Table 1 reports 2,077 ten-year observations with positive denominator, while the sample text calls the screen positive pretax income; the ETR denominator subtracts special items.
Table 2 regresses CASH ETR10 on a randomly chosen one-year CASH ETR1, excludes selected observations with negative denominators, and reports 1,891 all-observations.
Table 2 note says CASH ETR values are winsorized at zero and one.
Table 2 reports an intercept and CASH ETR1 slope for the selected all-observations regression; no underlying estimator is named.

Catalog entry for COMP.FUNDA at /storage/sas/base/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat. Used field labels include GVKEY, DATADATE, FYEAR, TXPD, PI, SPI, TXT, FIC, SICH, CONM, and CUSIP. Metadata supports discovery; labels and row counts do not establish sample coverage.
Successful exact-resource probe of COMP.FUNDA confirms the requested annual fields are present and readable; the sampled row is not coverage evidence.

review_notes: The assigned baseline is the Table 2 all-observations fit only: CASH ETR10 on CASH ETR1, with an intercept and 1,891 observations. Other Table 2 rows and Table 3 regressions remain outside the frozen fit.

The sample section says the ten-year screen is positive summed pretax income, while Table 1 describes the 2,077-firm measure as CASH ETR10 with a positive denominator. Because the numerator’s denominator is pretax income less special items, the exact source screen is unresolved; the frozen work item is left unchanged.

The table note specifies random one-year CASH ETR1 observations, negative-denominator exclusions, and winsorization at 0 and 1. It does not identify the draw procedure or selected fiscal year; treatment of zero denominators and missing special items is also unstated.

Current COMP.FUNDA field labels support the TXPD/PI/SPI measure mapping. Local historical population coverage is not confirmed, and FINC=0 / six-character CUSIP sample filters are not mapped to the current FIC/CUSIP representation.
